content.value: Assume a binary source (r=2) and a parser producing block messages of length M=2. Then we have $2 ^ { 2 } { = } 4$ possible messages {00. 01, 10, 11} at the input of the recency rank calculator. Suppose that the sequence of past messages before time K is; $\begin{array} { r l } { -- \bigl | V _ { K - 4 } \bigr | V _ { K - 3 } \bigl | V _ { K - 2 } \bigr | V _ { K - 1 } \bigr | N o w } & { = -- \bigl | 1 1 \bigr | 0 0 \bigr | 1 1 \bigr | 1 0 \bigr | 0 1 \bigr | 1 1 \bigr | 0 1 \bigr | N o w . } \end{array}$
Compute the recency rank list in the tabular form. Also express the rank values in second Elias code.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
